document.title: PMK 92/2023: Mekanisme pelaksanaan dan pertanggungjawaban atas pajak ditanggung pemerintah

delta.note: This regulation only covers the budgetary and accounting mechanism for government-borne taxes (Pajak DTP): KPA appointments, the SPP/SPM/SP2D process, SPTJM, and accounting policy. It sets no PPh 21 rate, threshold, facility or calculation step for permanent employees. Pasal 3 leaves the choice of incentivised tax objects to separate ministerial regulations. It is purely administrative.
